form_notes_verbatim: Include total number of bedrooms in home, even if we won't be cleaning them. Round up for half baths. We'll credit you $10.00 for each room not being cleaned, just leave a note in the comment section.

We HIGHLY recommend a deep cleaning for homes not cleaned for 30 days and for first visits to get your home prepared for ongoing maintenance service. For all move in/out cleans, homes must be empty prior to cleaners arrival.
tax: No sales-tax line shown on the booking summary (Super Cleaning and the BookingKoala sites show 6%).
